# ppk2-lib

> Python library + CLI for Nordic's Power Profiler Kit II (PPK2):
> calibrated current + logic captures at 100 kSPS, GUI-parity CSV
> output, source/ammeter modes, scriptable DUT power control, and
> energy attribution via GPIO trace markers. EXPERIMENTAL — the API
> may change between 0.x versions; not yet on PyPI (install from
> git).

Import name and binary are `ppk2`; the distribution is `ppk2-lib`.
Three layers: `ppk2.protocol` (stdlib-only wire primitives),
`ppk2.client` (pyserial session driver), `ppk2.cli` (typer binary).
One process owns the PPK2 at a time; quit the Nordic GUI before
capturing. Captures are boot-inclusive (DUT power-cycles at t=0).

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, quick start, layer table, dev workflow
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): three-layer design, session lifecycle (sequence diagram), threading model
- [Protocol notes](docs/PROTOCOL.md): opcodes, metadata format, sample frame, stream reassembly, calibration formula, CSV format, firmware caveats
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): 0.1.0 feature list and known limitations

## Firmware

- [Reference bench DUT](firmware/bench-dut/README.md): deterministic D0/D1 signal for HIL tests; wiring + per-board pins (nRF52840/nRF54L15/nRF54LM20 DKs)
- [Trace-marker demo](firmware/trace-demo/README.md): C + C++ RAII markers for energy attribution, both-mode flash/capture recipes, reference measurements

## Validation

- [A/B harness](validation/README.md): statistical capture comparison (means, KS, per-pin rates) + acceptance contract
- [Committed evidence](validation/evidence/trace_demo/README.md): GUI-vs-CLI parity rounds with reference captures and plots

- [Claude Code skill](.claude/skills/ppk2/SKILL.md): operational recipes for driving the PPK2 from an AI coding agent
